inputs.value: @and(equals(body('Get_folder_scope')?['HasUniqueRoleAssignments'], true), equals(length(body('Folder_grants')), 2), contains(body('Folder_grants'), concat(string(outputs('Ids')?['owners']), ':', first(body('Role_full_control'))?['Name'], ':1')), contains(body('Folder_grants'), concat(string(outputs('Sender_id')), ':1-to-1 Submit:1')))

Verdict.inputs: @if(not(outputs('Sender_ok')), 'Not sent from your own update folder', if(empty(string(coalesce(body('Get_action')?['Id'], ''))), 'Not your action', if(not(equals(string(body('Get_action')?['Technician']?['Id']), string(outputs('Sender_id')))), 'Not your action', if(equals(body('Get_action')?['Status'], 'Closed'), 'The action is closed', if(not(contains(createArray('progress', 'waiting', 'followup', 'closeRequest'), string(coalesce(body('Get_update')?['Kind'], '')))), 'Unknown kind of update', if(and(contains(createArray('progress', 'waiting'), string(coalesce(body('Get_update')?['Kind'], ''))), empty(trim(string(coalesce(body('Get_update')?['Message'], ''))))), 'The update is empty', if(and(equals(string(coalesce(body('Get_update')?['Kind'], '')), 'followup'), not(contains(createArray('Satisfactory', 'Support', 'Ready'), string(coalesce(body('Get_update')?['Outcome'], ''))))), 'Unknown follow-up outcome', if(and(or(equals(string(coalesce(body('Get_update')?['Kind'], '')), 'closeRequest'), and(equals(string(coalesce(body('Get_update')?['Kind'], '')), 'followup'), equals(string(coalesce(body('Get_update')?['Outcome'], '')), 'Ready'))), not(equals(body('Get_action')?['Owner'], 'Technician'))), 'Only the Team Leader closes their own actions', if(not(equals(actions('Parse_history')?['status'], 'Succeeded')), 'The action history could not be read – tell your Team Leader', '')))))))))

inputs.Status: @if(or(equals(string(coalesce(body('Get_update')?['Kind'], '')), 'closeRequest'), and(equals(string(coalesce(body('Get_update')?['Kind'], '')), 'followup'), equals(string(coalesce(body('Get_update')?['Outcome'], '')), 'Ready'))), 'Ready for close-out', if(equals(string(coalesce(body('Get_update')?['Kind'], '')), 'waiting'), 'Waiting', if(and(equals(string(coalesce(body('Get_update')?['Kind'], '')), 'progress'), contains(createArray('Open', 'Waiting'), body('Get_action')?['Status'])), 'In progress', body('Get_action')?['Status'])))

Verdict_again.inputs: @if(not(outputs('Sender_ok')), 'Not sent from your own update folder', if(empty(string(coalesce(body('Get_action_again')?['Id'], ''))), 'Not your action', if(not(equals(string(body('Get_action_again')?['Technician']?['Id']), string(outputs('Sender_id')))), 'Not your action', if(equals(body('Get_action_again')?['Status'], 'Closed'), 'The action is closed', if(not(contains(createArray('progress', 'waiting', 'followup', 'closeRequest'), string(coalesce(body('Get_update')?['Kind'], '')))), 'Unknown kind of update', if(and(contains(createArray('progress', 'waiting'), string(coalesce(body('Get_update')?['Kind'], ''))), empty(trim(string(coalesce(body('Get_update')?['Message'], ''))))), 'The update is empty', if(and(equals(string(coalesce(body('Get_update')?['Kind'], '')), 'followup'), not(contains(createArray('Satisfactory', 'Support', 'Ready'), string(coalesce(body('Get_update')?['Outcome'], ''))))), 'Unknown follow-up outcome', if(and(or(equals(string(coalesce(body('Get_update')?['Kind'], '')), 'closeRequest'), and(equals(string(coalesce(body('Get_update')?['Kind'], '')), 'followup'), equals(string(coalesce(body('Get_update')?['Outcome'], '')), 'Ready'))), not(equals(body('Get_action_again')?['Owner'], 'Technician'))), 'Only the Team Leader closes their own actions', if(not(equals(actions('Parse_history_again')?['status'], 'Succeeded')), 'The action history could not be read – tell your Team Leader', '')))))))))

inputs.Status: @if(or(equals(string(coalesce(body('Get_update')?['Kind'], '')), 'closeRequest'), and(equals(string(coalesce(body('Get_update')?['Kind'], '')), 'followup'), equals(string(coalesce(body('Get_update')?['Outcome'], '')), 'Ready'))), 'Ready for close-out', if(equals(string(coalesce(body('Get_update')?['Kind'], '')), 'waiting'), 'Waiting', if(and(equals(string(coalesce(body('Get_update')?['Kind'], '')), 'progress'), contains(createArray('Open', 'Waiting'), body('Get_action_again')?['Status'])), 'In progress', body('Get_action_again')?['Status'])))
